title: Stereotype Detection in LLMs: A Multiclass, Explainable, and Benchmark-Driven Approach
reasoning: The paper explicitly identifies 'religion' as one of the four core societal dimensions (alongside race, profession, and gender) used to evaluate and benchmark stereotypes in LLMs. It includes specific performance metrics for the religion category, qualitative explainability analysis focused on religious terms, and an extensive library of prompts designed to elicit religious stereotypes.
